classified_findings: MiMo-V2.6 Flash/Pro cannot serve with correct semantics via the official vLLM image on SM80: sinks + DiffKV attention both resolve to FA3 (SM90+), and the DiffKV backend is pinned in model code so no backend override escapes it.
SGLang is the viable SM80 path so far: native mxfp4 routed-expert detection, sinks plumbed through the triton backend, mimo_v2_nextn.py present for the shipped MTP/DFlash drafter.
PP3 is memory-infeasible on 3x 64 GiB for this 161 GiB checkpoint with the sglang loader (load-time transients exceed the ~9.8 GiB slack).

A5: eager mode confirms the Triton fused-MoE path cannot consume mxfp4-packed expert weights on SM80 under any mode - shape assert under capture, raw CUDA fault in eager. Both official runtimes are excluded without porting work (mxfp4->fp8/bf16 expert repack at load, or an Ampere mxfp4 kernel).
